nodes.label: dial
nodes.doc: Read a numeric dial by its qualified <ClassName>.<DialName> id -- a scope handle may be any scope, so the owner is never implied. This is the DYNAMIC read; the typed one is the per-dial get node, which is picked and carries the dial's real type.
